scope: Same-host TCP. All native cells run five times; every sample retained. Diagnostic captures use separate short budgets and never enter timing results.
goal: portable mean and pooled p50 < fixed C++ independently, and positive reads/writes plus attempts <= C++ independently per process capture.
statistics: mean_ns is the pooled arithmetic mean; displayed ± run SD is sample SD (n-1) across five run means, not a confidence interval. Sample SD and extrema are retained separately.

selection.reason: Bounded empty-phase walk reaches the next owned operation in one budgeted step and reduces measured maintenance dispatch work, while preserving per-owner limits, fairness, capacity and callback ordering.
selection.native_conclusion: No established end-to-end latency speedup. Focused pipeline mean/median improved 12.7%/5.1%, but full campaign regressed 3.8%/3.0%. All data retained.
selection.remaining: Question-owned observer settlement, explicit mutation/maintenance obligations, concurrent service-chain batching and universal C++ performance/I/O parity.

description: The selected source passes **154 allocating wire tests**, **101 no-allocation wire tests**, **336 RPC library tests**, and **nine TCP/Unix integration tests**, plus strict Clippy for the RPC and wire crates, and workspace formatting. The isolated portability matrix passes core (86), alloc (89), growing (89), std (86), and unaligned/sync_reader (86) test executions. Bare-metal thumbv7em-none-eabi checks pass for both core and alloc wire profiles. Full coverage, Miri and formal suites were not rerun.

The growth fixture now retains its observer for the first Pending poll, then drops it before later bindings grow. This preserves its intended mid-scan growth precondition without relying on empty-phase budget consumption. The other adjusted test explicitly invalidates a partial scan after externally releasing a graph observer; its later deferred-answer/export idle-certificate checks still omit invalidation as before. The benchmark executable was rechecked after this verification-only fixture adjustment and remains byte-identical.
